text.p: TRW Inc said Thursday it anticipates a good performance for the rest of the year.
Company spokesman Jay MacCaffrey said TRW expects to double its size in seven years as measured by sales and relative market capitalization.
He said the company does not provide sales or earnings per share projected estimates.

Earlier today, the company reported first quarter sales of $2.66 billion, up from $2.51 billion in 1996. Earnings from continuing operations were $119.2 million, up from the 1996 figure of $102.7 million, which included an $11.8 million benefit and a $12.6 million noncash charge. 1997 first quarter earnings per share from continuing operations were $0.92 versus $0.76 in 1996.

"We expect good performance for the remainder of 1997. The strength of the world economy and the good outlook for our industries, as well as our global strategy, strong competitiveness, improving operations, financial flexibility, and acquisitions strategy, give us confidence that our expectations can be achieved," the company said in a release.
